ms.report:
CIP-30 wrapper packages
We have created two CIP-30 wrapper packages as a result of the second milestone.

The first is https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-cip30 - which was forked from Anton Kholomiov’s (a former MLabs employee) personal repo.

The following changes have been made since the fork:
・https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-cip30/pull/5 - added Nix-based CI setup, to adapt the repo to automation standards of MLabs
・https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-cip30/pull/4
・Added PureScript wrappers for newly introduced CIP-30 methods: getExtensions / getSupportedExtensions 
・made WalletName a type synonym instead of newtype and got rid of mentions of particular wallets in the library code
・Switched to untagged-union in FFI

The second package, created from scratch, is https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-cip30-typesafe

It is a wrapper on top of purescript-cip30 that takes care of error responses from the CIP-30 API, and forces the user to explicitly handle them.
The motivation for a separate package is that not all users of purescript-cip30 care about error variants.
For us, however, type safety does matter.

This PR https://github.com/Plutonomicon/cardano-transaction-lib/pull/1583 introduced the use of purescript-cip30 and purescript-cip30-typesafe to cardano-transaction-lib.

Links to commits with the final versions:

ms.promise:
・Since the beginning, we have been using our own, manually written PureScript bindings for cardano-serialization-lib (CSL for short). But since we created them, a better PureScript wrapper library has appeared - https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/purescript-cardano-serialization-lib The output of this milestone is the removal of our bindings and inclusion of this library as a replacement. 
・We noticed that sometimes it makes sense to use domain types of CTL separately from the CTL itself. Currently, there is no way to depend only on the types. The outputs of this milestone are two packages: for cardano-domain and plutus-domain types.
ms.criteria:
・There is no CSL wrapper code left in CTL. All conversion operations use purescript-cardano-serialization-lib.
・Two new repositories with PureScript packages are created: for Cardano domain types and Plutus domain types.
